title: Hearty Juicy British Green Red Lentils Afternoon Tea Sandwich
description: A romantic British dish featuring green red lentils, soffritto-base, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a bitter and juicy afternoon tea experience.
instructions: In a large pot, bring 2 cups of water to a boil and add the green red lentils, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery, then cook until the vegetables are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dijon mustard and apple cider vinegar.
Add the cooked lentils to the skillet with the vegetables and stir in the mustard mixture.
Season the lentil mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Arrange the whole wheat bread triangles on a serving plate.
Spoon the lentil mixture onto the bread triangles.
Top the lentil mixture with lettuce leaves and tomato slices.
Serve the sandwiches immediately and enjoy.
